# S11 — TUI shell, project tabs and Overview

The first screen: `ork` opens a Bubble Tea TUI with project tabs, the
Overview and the status line, reading through S02's `Source`.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:** the Roadmap and Decisions screens (S12), the Waves screen, the daemon, and any write.

## Why

The monitoring dashboard is half of v1 (`scope.v1`), and needs-you first
is its first principle (docs/dashboard.md).

## Files

- `go.mod`, `go.sum`: add Bubble Tea, Lip Gloss and Bubbles only
  (`stack.go-deps`).
- `cmd/ork/main.go`: start the TUI; `--version`.
- `internal/tui/`: the app model, tabs, status line, Overview, help, theme.
- `internal/poll/`: the refresh schedule.
- `testdata/golden/`: rendered views at fixed sizes.
- `NOTICE`: the three libraries and their licenses.

## Failing tests

- Update functions, with a fake `Source`: tab switch keys, `r` refresh,
  `?` help, `q` quit.
- Polling: the visible project refreshes every 5 s and the others every
  30 s; `r` refreshes the visible one now; a call in flight is never
  started twice (`dash.refresh`).
- A call that has not returned shows as pending on its row; a failed call
  shows its error code and message verbatim.
- The tab badge counts what needs the owner: open adj records plus slicer
  items held `needs-owner`. The bell rings once when the count rises, not
  on every refresh (`ui.notify`).
- Relays from `slicer relay-run list --active` show under Running with a
  "started elsewhere" marker and no actions (`dash.external-runs`).
- Golden views at 100x30 and 80x24, colour and monochrome, match
  `testdata/golden/`; `NO_COLOR` selects monochrome.

## Implement

- [HUMAN CHECK] Before adding each library, read its LICENSE in its

- Overview sections: Needs you (open decisions and held items in v1 so

- Every coloured state also has a word or symbol.
